The important distinction is between a verified manufacturer of record, a stated China origin and an exact factory for a particular unit. Those claims need different evidence.

Its 2025 company update describes research, manufacturing and sales of consumer 3D printers, laser engravers and STEM products. That is a stronger manufacturer claim than simply seeing the name on a marketplace product listing.

Elegoo also reports office and manufacturing space in Shenzhen. Even so, it does not follow that every Centauri, Mars or Saturn printer is assembled in the same building. Check the origin label on the exact model you receive.

Flashforge is a useful nearby comparison because it also sells consumer 3D printers from a Chinese manufacturing business. Elegoo’s range gives buyers a visible choice between filament and resin; Flashforge also extends into business equipment.
